comparison.objective: Screen ceramic media from washers, versus harvest apples into a bucket.
comparison.physical_skill: Granular-flow control versus lift-and-twist detachment and gentle transport of fragile fruit.
comparison.success_condition: Media recovered with every washer retained, versus two undropped apples bucketed with stems on and spurs unbroken.
comparison.reason: Retention and loss avoidance are generic constraints, not the same tested manipulation.
